hypothesis_origin: Human-authored prospective design; not a machine prediction
question: Can fixed-budget targeted refresh restore strict start recall on engraving rows 0 and 1 from the pinned gen16 continuation without losing previously passing protected rows, while all seven post-epoch engraving losses meet the declared floor?
classification_if_successful: PROSPECTIVE_CASE_STUDY; no causal targeted-refresh effect without a separately registered matched comparator

parent.hash_provenance: Operator's read-only streaming-hash receipt; not rehashed by this lab

planned_training.optimizer: AdamW on explicitly verified trainable continuation parameters; freeze full optimizer defaults in the runtime lock
planned_training.scheduler: LambdaLR, factor 0.8 per completed epoch; retain exact source scheduling only after runtime qualification
planned_training.input_truncation: REFUSE silently truncated prompts or chosen targets; log lengths before registration
planned_training.base_loading_dtype: bfloat16; actual adapter/gradient/optimizer dtypes must be measured and recorded
planned_training.engraving_target_share: 100/140 = 5/7; planned new knob, not an existing source setting
planned_training.training_order: 146 corpus rows in bound source order, then deterministic deficit-balanced engraving schedule; schedule file must be hashed in final registration

new_gate.loss_metric: After each full epoch, eval-mode/no-grad teacher-forced assistant-target loss on EACH of all seven engraving rows; maximum raw finite loss <= 0.001
new_gate.recall_metric: Greedy max_new_tokens=120; target=chosen.strip()[:240] Unicode characters, required nonempty. Primary pass iff generated.strip().startswith(target); decode policy bound with tokenizer. This is strict character-prefix recall, not byte or full-completion equality.
new_gate.source_legacy_substring_recall: Record as a secondary diagnostic only; never substitute for new strict-prefix gate
new_gate.seven_row_requirement: All seven loss and strict-prefix recall gates must pass after epoch >=3
new_gate.checkpoint_selection: First fully completed passing gate at epoch >=3, otherwise final completed epoch recorded as FAIL; wall/budget cut-short is INCOMPLETE
new_gate.pre_post_protected_rows: Record all seven parent baselines and final rows; any previously passing strict-prefix recall regression is FAIL
new_gate.restoration_claim_precondition: At least one target row must fail the registered strict-prefix parent baseline. If both target rows already pass, do not start this restoration trial; revise and register a different evidence question before training.
new_gate.unsupported_or_nonfinite_run: INVALID or FAILED, never assumed success

budget_and_deadline.paid_deadline_formula: min(14400 seconds, proposed shorter cap, verified budget deadline after all unavoidable costs and teardown reserve); measured from provider billing start, not first optimizer step

operator_provisional_quote.ongoing_CPU_and_object_storage_cost_scop: Must be explicitly defined and logged; no zero assumption or mutation authorized

resource_qualification.operator_latest_allocated_shape: 1gpu-16vcpu-200gb on gpu-h200-sxm; existing 200GiB NETWORK_SSD boot and existing secondary disk
resource_qualification.base_model_parameter_count_and_weight_by: UNRECOVERED; generic source path is not model identity
resource_qualification.actual_CUDA_environment: UNVERIFIED; local installed package metadata cannot stand in for remote runtime
resource_qualification.adapter_config_PEFT_writer_version_repor: 0.20.0; qualify intended remote PEFT, do not assume local 0.17.1 compatibility
resource_qualification.planned_duration: No throughput estimate without smoke measurement; phase values are maximum proposed allowances only
resource_qualification.setup_smoke: Validate local-only loading, seven-row baseline, one bounded forward/backward and checkpoint save/reload under a controller deadline; use a disposable copy/reset state before the single registered trial
resource_qualification.disk_headroom: Operator must verify free space on an existing permitted volume using measured smoke checkpoint size, maximum seven saves, atomic-write reserve and log margin. Historical 99%-full root does not qualify.
resource_qualification.operator_existing_disk_inventory: 200GiB NETWORK_SSD boot plus 186GiB NRD; free space unverified

outputs.checkpoint_names: checkpoint-epoch-N within the new run root, never generation labels in the original tree
outputs.checkpoint_scope: adapter-only plus adapter config; NOT a resumable training-state checkpoint. Interrupted trial is INCOMPLETE and not resumed in this window.

registration_rule: Only a new manifest with every mandatory input/control binding present, safe runner hash, frozen schedule, approved existing paths and operator resource receipts may be locked. This DRAFT and its current hash do not preregister an executed experiment or authorize spending.
